name: io.github.weed33834/agentseed
description: AgentSeed MCP Server — 面向自主智能体的高约束规则治理：P0 安全红线检查（governance_check）、场景规则包列表/激活（scenario_list / scenario_activate）、能力缺口检测（gap_detect）。

tools.name: governance_check
tools.description: Check if a tool call violates P0 security red lines (destructive ops, hardcoded secrets, auto-installing MCP servers). Tool-name agnostic.

tools.name: scenario_list
tools.description: List available scenario packs (场景规则包). Alias of persona_list.

tools.name: scenario_activate
tools.description: Activate a scenario pack and return its configuration summary. Alias of persona_activate.

tools.name: gap_detect
tools.description: Analyze context for capability gaps based on the self-evolution gap score formula.

notes: 安装: pip install https://github.com/weed33834/agentseed/releases/download/v1.0.0/agentseed-1.0.0-py3-none-any.whl；随后在任意 MCP 客户端添加 { "mcpServers": { "agentseed": { "command": "agentseed", "args": ["serve"] } } }
